tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build Starter Project
tasks.command: bash -c 'source ~/.local/bin/get_idf 2>/dev/null || source ~/esp/esp-idf/export.sh && cd templates/esp32s3_starter && idf.py build'

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Flash & Monitor Starter Project
tasks.command: bash -c 'source ~/.local/bin/get_idf 2>/dev/null || source ~/esp/esp-idf/export.sh && cd templates/esp32s3_starter && idf.py flash monitor'

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Full Clean Starter Project
tasks.command: bash -c 'source ~/.local/bin/get_idf 2>/dev/null || source ~/esp/esp-idf/export.sh && cd templates/esp32s3_starter && idf.py fullclean'
